description: Create Laviya tasks from a work list the user has explicitly approved and return taskID/customTaskID per referenceID. Only call after the user approved the exact list and the target project (projectID, chosen with laviya_list_projects); never call it from an orchestrated execution. All items are created together or none; resending the same list (same requestKey) returns the already created tasks instead of duplicating them.

methodologyStatusID.description: Task-creatable status of the project. Defaults to Backlog, Planned, Processing, ...

projectID.description: Laviya project the user chose for this list (see laviya_list_projects). Never assumed from configuration.

requestKey.description: Idempotency key. Defaults to a hash of the list, so resending the same list returns the same tasks.

assigneeEmails.description: E-mails of tenant members to assign. Omit to assign yourself. Assigning others requires PM permission (PM, Director or Admin).

description.description: Plain text; Laviya stores it as escaped HTML.

estimatedEffortHours.description: Estimate in hours; Laviya stores minutes.

parentReferenceID.description: referenceID of an earlier item of this call.

parentTaskID.description: Existing task of the same project.

referenceID.description: Stable key of the work-list item (e.g. W-03). Defaults to the 1-based item position.

taskTypeID.description: 0 Task, 10 Bug, 20 ChangeRequest, 30 Improvement, 40 Debt, 50 Suggestion, 60 Meeting, 70 Story, 80 Epic. Default 0.

title.description: Title of the delivery run that groups the created tasks on the Delivery runs screen.

name: laviya_create_tasks
title: Create Approved Tasks
